specs.label: carrying method, built to your load

cards.title: It watches where it goes
cards.body: The live view on the left is what its laser safety scanner sees right now. On the move, the AGV stops for people in its path and continues by itself once the way is clear.

cards.title: Two ways to find its way
cards.body: Start with magnetic tape on the floor today. When your layout changes, the same vehicle can move to tape-free navigation.

cards.title: Follows a line, reliably
cards.body: The AGV follows a magnetic strip on the floor and stops at marked stations. Quick to install, easy to change: move the tape, change the route.

cards.title: Learns your factory
cards.body: Drive it around the site once and it builds its own map. Routes are drawn on a screen. No floor work at all.

cards.title: Stop it any time
cards.body: Emergency stop buttons sit on the vehicle, within reach from every side. One press stops the drive at once.

cards.title: Made for your material flow
cards.body: Tell us what you move, how far and how often. We configure AGV I-PRIME for your load, your route and your line.
